analysis_kind: Authorized same-data CPU Native checkpoint replay and centered physical-input finite differences

method.time_base: CSV relative bag timestamps, no resampling or filtering
method.state_alignment: Previous debug row; reconstruct gyro*0.25, projected gravity from raw quaternion, commands, q-default, dq*0.05, previous raw action from recorded targets
method.history: ROA 10 oldest-first frames with first-frame startup padding; DWAQ prior analysis used 5. Filled-history windows start at offset 10.
method.shared_previous_actions: All models receive original recorded ROA actions. None of the replay outputs is fed back.
method.local_sensitivity: Centered differences of hip target angles with respect to physical current-frame hip position or velocity. Full_model_current perturbs current frame in both encoder and actor; actor_direct holds encoder outputs fixed. Older frames are unchanged.
method.summary_gain: Largest singular value of 2x2 Jacobian, summarized by median over window; position gain rad/rad, velocity gain rad/(rad/s). This is not a physical closed-loop gain or damping ratio.
method.freeze_current_hip: Only actor current q,dq fixed at pre-entry values, encoder outputs preserved
method.freeze_all_history_hip: Both hip q,dq replaced by pre-entry values in all history frames
method.zero_velocity_code: Explicit velocity code set to zero, other codes and current inputs preserved
method.observation_layout: gyro*0.25 [0:3], raw-quaternion inverse gravity [3:6], zero command [6:9], q-default including two zero wheel position slots [9:19], dq*0.05 [19:29], recorded previous raw action [29:39]
method.policy_mode: deterministic CPU float32, one thread, hist_encoding=True; velocity estimation on; no action feedback
method.nominal_pd: 90*(predicted hip target - previous-row hip q) - 3*previous-row hip dq; demand only, not measured torque
method.plant: No simulator or hardware dynamics are executed; predicted actions are not fed back.
method.new_model_export: No export or archive; checkpoint loaded strictly into repository ActorCriticROA
method.models: Sep16, Sep19, Sep21 ROA Native; archived DWAQ analysis only

limitations: Only 29 recorded frames from the old failing policy, not a new-policy physical rollout.
First 10 frames use approximate startup history; filled-history windows are reported separately.
Late states and recorded previous actions may be out of the new policy distribution.
The maximum singular value discards feedback sign/phase; smaller velocity sensitivity is not automatically more damping or better stability.
No measured base linear velocity; reconstructed code cannot establish actual velocity-estimator error.
Open-loop input freezes and velocity zeroing do not establish physical causation or contribution percentages.
DWAQ results are reused from a prior analysis on these same ROA incident inputs, not DWAQ hardware data.
Actuator delay is a plant parameter, not inserted into this open-loop neural replay. This compares the learned policies, not closed-loop delay stability.
This is the earlier Sep18 startup oscillation record, not the later right-turn incident without a log.
